attchmntText: Shrenik Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Shrenik Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. CA Rahul Nareshbhai Shah is the Resolution Professional. The results were taken on record on 5th November 2026. The advertisement was published in Financial Express and Financial Express Gujarati on 7th November 2026. Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited published its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 1130.76 Lakhs. Net profit for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was 2504.56 Lakhs. Shlokka Dyes Limited issued a notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting on 28th November 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing. Remote e-voting will be conducted by National Securities Depository Limited. Remote e-voting starts on 25th November 2026 at 09:00 AM and ends on 27th November 2026 at 05:00 PM.

attchmntText: Shrenik Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
